opportunities.name: GitHub developer lead research and recruiting email draft
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub username, open the user profile and top repo, then compose an email to hiring@example.com with a lead summary (followers, top repo, stars, latest post).
steps: Click GitHub search and type the username
Press Enter and click the Users results tab
Open mail compose and enter the hiring address in To
Enter body summarizing followers, top repo with stars and language, latest post

Add a note with the findings
